I pushed the refactor from a primitive-only helper into a more general sorting utility.

[InsertionSort.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/035_insertion_sort/InsertionSort.java:1) now supports both `int[]` and generic object arrays. Internally, the public methods now delegate into dedicated primitive and generic insertion-sort paths instead of baking everything into one special-case implementation.
